What was checked

Typecheck, full geometry/state tests and build; actual folds and reversals; old and new captures together; paper offsets; repeated moves to bounds; layers; remove/Undo; quota retry and cross-tab preservation; reload; exact 1800 × 2100 composite PNG. An independent sizing review found one export-control issue, which was fixed and rechecked.

Five ordinary pieces used about 115k saved characters in the composed candidate; heavy bow-and-centre stress cases used about 254k of the unchanged two-million-character limit. Texture costs justify stopping at five. Older PR23 readers preserve, but cannot open, five-piece saves or newly introduced paper recipes.

Production and the reviewed PR23 preview remain unchanged. CI status and the exact candidate commit belong to the draft PR. Owner review, physical-paper trial and real-phone testing remain the next gates.
